items.title: Masco (MAS) Appoints Its First Chief Marketing Officer To Push Brand Growth
items.summary: Masco (NYSE:MAS) has appointed Brad Hiranaga as its first Chief Marketing Officer. The new role focuses on brand growth, digital acceleration, and customer-centric product and service development. Hiranaga joins Masco with prior leadership roles at Marriott, General Mills, and Cotopaxi. Masco is drawing fresh attention from investors with this new executive position centered on marketing and commercial execution. items.title: Walmart (WMT) Launches 40,000 Acre Regenerative Agriculture Effort With General Mills And ADM
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT), General Mills and ADM are working together on a new regenerative agriculture program. The initiative covers 40,000 Midwest wheat acres with goals tied to soil health, water quality and carbon sequestration. The collaboration is designed as a model for broader industry change across food and retail supply chains. items.title: ADM (NYSE:ADM) Appoints Jeff Rowe As COO And Expands Regenerative Agriculture
items.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland (NYSE:ADM) has created a new Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer role and appointed Jeff Rowe to the position. Rowe will oversee key operational and research and development functions across ADM. ADM has also announced a partnership with General Mills and Walmart to promote regenerative agriculture across 40,000 Midwest wheat acres.
